text: The Manager, Business Services, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, the Project Officer Development, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, and the Senior Public Consultation Coordinator, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, will give a presentation on Golf Operational Review. The City of Toronto is conducting an operational review of our five City-operated golf course locations to better understand how to maximize golf and non-golf experiences. As part of the consultation process that will inform recommendations to Council, the project team will provide the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee with a project overview and collect feedback on current and potential future uses of the five City-operated golf courses.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to incorporate the Committee's feedback into the work on Golf Operational Review.
